basic_details.job_title: KBCAOS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Research Associate, Junior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: The K. Banerjee Centre of Atmospheric and Ocean Studies (KBCAOS), University of Allahabad (A Central University), Prayagraj, has invited applications for one Research Associate II post (Rs. 61000 per month + HRA) and one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post (Rs. 37000 per month + HRA) under the DST Centre of Excellence in Climate Change. The posts are on the DST, Govt. of India sponsored project "Variability and Predictability of Indian Monsoon in a Changing Climate". Prepare an application giving full educational details and research experience.
Attach the supporting documents and a photograph.
Write the name of the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the email to [email protected] so that it reaches latest by 20 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: KBCAOS Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists two posts, one vacancy each, so the total is 2. No category-wise break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives essential and desirable qualifications for each post. Desirable items mean preference "will be given" to candidates having them; they are not compulsory. Essential qualification: (a) one of the following routes, and (b) one research publication. Doctoral Degree (PhD) in Science with a Post Graduate Degree in Atmospheric and Ocean Science/Meteorology/Earth System Science/Geophysics/Physics/Mathematics/Statistics/Computer Science; OR Three Years' relevant experience of research and development in an Academic Institution or Science and Technology organization after ME/MTech degree in Earth System Science/Meteorology/Atmosphere/Ocean/Marine/Mechanical/Civil/Computer Engineering/Information Technology from Govt. recognized Universities/Institutes. (b) One (01) research publication in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journals of repute. Desirable (preference will be given to candidates having): Knowledge of Mathematical Modeling, Climate Models, Variability and Predictability of Indian Monsoon, Big Data Analysis and Display tools, Artificial Intelligence, HPC, LINUX, MATLAB, C++, Python. PhD degree in relevant discipline and at least three (03) research publications in SCI journals of repute. At least 60% marks at the Post Graduate degree (MSc/ME/MTech) level. Essential qualification: (a) one of the following routes, and (b) a cleared national-level test. Post Graduate Degree (MSc/MTech) in Atmospheric and Ocean Science/Earth System Science/Meteorology/Geophysics/Physics/Mathematics/Statistics/Computer Science; OR BE/BTech/MTech degree in Meteorology/Atmosphere/Ocean/Marine/Mechanical/Civil/Computer Engineering/Information Technology from Govt. recognized Universities/Institutes. (b) Must have cleared UGC NET/CSIR NET/GATE/National Level Examinations conducted by Central Govt. Departments and their Agencies and Institutions. Desirable (preference will be given to candidates having): Knowledge of Big Data Analysis and Display tools, Mathematical Modeling, Climate Models, Artificial Intelligence, HPC, LINUX, MATLAB, C++, Python. At least 60% marks at the Under Graduate and Post Graduate degree level. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate II fellowship is Rs. 61000 per month + HRA, and the JRF fellowship is Rs. 37000 per month + HRA. The terms and conditions of the research fellowship are as per DST OM No. DST/PCPM/Z-06/2022 dated 26/06/2023 read with OM No. SR/S9/Z-08/2018 dated 30/01/2019. Appointment on the project positions is initially for one year. It may continue till the duration or end of the project, subject to satisfactory performance in the periodic work appraisals/reviews.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KBCAOS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks for applications by email only. The steps it gives are: Prepare an application giving full educational details and research experience. Attach the supporting documents and a photograph. Write the name of the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the email to [email protected] so that it reaches latest by 20 December 2026. Do not send a hard copy; the notice says no hardcopy applications should be submitted. Documents named in the notice: full educational details and research experience, supporting documents, and a photograph.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted strictly on the basis of merit and project requirements. Mere possession of the prescribed qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the date and place of interview, so a correct and operational email address must be given in the application. The notice does not print an interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be entertained. No hardcopy applications should be submitted. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Continuation beyond the first year depends on satisfactory performance in periodic work appraisals/reviews.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KBCAOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Research Associate II and one Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KBCAOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach [email protected] latest by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Research Associate II at KBCAOS?
faq.answer: A PhD in Science with a Post Graduate Degree in the listed disciplines, or three years' relevant R&D experience after ME/MTech in the listed disciplines, plus one SCI research publication.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the JRF post at KBCAOS?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree (MSc/MTech) in the listed disciplines, or a BE/BTech/MTech in the listed engineering disciplines, and a cleared UGC NET/CSIR NET/GATE/National Level Examination conducted by Central Govt. Departments and their Agencies and Institutions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for KBCAOS Research Associate II and JRF?
faq.answer: Research Associate II gets Rs. 61000 per month + HRA, and JRF gets Rs. 37000 per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, both fellowships are printed as the amount "+ HRA". The HRA amount is not given in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for KBCAOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the application with full educational details, research experience, supporting documents and a photograph to [email protected], with the post name in the subject line. Hard copies are not to be submitted.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted strictly on merit and project requirements, and shortlisted candidates are informed by email of the interview date and place.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on project positions, initially for one year, and may continue till the end of the project subject to satisfactory performance in periodic appraisals.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
